entities.summary: Michael "Mikko" Kozarowitzky is a Finnish former racing driver. With a solid background in various lower formulae, he reached Formula One in 1977. Driving for the RAM team, which was then running March 761 cars, Kozarowitzky entered the 1977 Swedish Grand Prix, where he failed to qualify mainly thanks to a lack of testing time in the car.
